name: Iron Freeze
look: a faceted ice crystal column with a black visor of glowing yellow dots, huge blocky crystal arms with glowing claws, glowing crystal wings and hovering crystal feet
entry: A Pokémon resembling Regice, sketched in an expedition report about a glacier that hummed with current. Its crystal body is chilled close to absolute zero by the power racing through it, and the lights on its visor flash in a code no one has deciphered.
how: Wild: very rare in frozen biomes (ice spikes, frozen peaks, snowy slopes).
